content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Notification 2026 PDF Out
content_sections.text: The District Programme Officer, Kushinagar, issued the Anganwadi Helper recruitment notification on 19 August 2026. The recruitment is being conducted for vacant Anganwadi Helper posts in different Child Development Project areas of Kushinagar district. According to the notification, applications will be accepted only from eligible female candidates through the departmental online portal. The recruitment process will be conducted according to the applicable government instructions issued by the Child Development Services and Nutrition Department, Uttar Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit their applications before the deadline. The notification specifically states that online applications for the advertised posts will be accepted up to 11 September 2026 at 12:00 midnight.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: A total of 214 Anganwadi Helper posts have been notified across different Child Development Project areas of Kushinagar district. The category-wise reservation details are included within the vacancy figures below. Total: 214 posts (SC-55, ST-02, OBC-57, UR-100). The notification states that detailed Gram Panchayat-wise and Ward-wise vacancy, reservation and eligibility information has been uploaded on the departmental portal.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised Anganwadi Helper vacancies. The notification specifies residence, educational qualification and age-related conditions that candidates must satisfy. The minimum educational qualification for the post of Anganwadi Helper is Intermediate (Class 12th) or equivalent. The notification states that the merit will be determined from the Intermediate qualification up to postgraduate qualification. Candidates should use the educational qualification and marks information specified in their official academic documents while completing the online application. The prescribed minimum age for the Anganwadi Helper post is 18 years, while the maximum age is 35 years. The age will be calculated as on 1 July 2026. The date of birth mentioned in the candidate's High School marksheet and certificate will be considered valid for determining age. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying. For the vacant Anganwadi Helper post, the applicant must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha for the relevant rural area vacancy or the same ward for the relevant urban area vacancy. This residence condition is an important eligibility requirement. Candidates should carefully check the Gram Panchayat-wise or Ward-wise vacancy information before submitting the application. The notification refers to income eligibility based on the applicable Uttar Pradesh government instructions. It states annual family income limits of Rs.46,080 for rural areas and Rs.56,460 for urban areas for the relevant income criteria. Only income certificates issued and verified according to the instructions mentioned in the notification will be considered. The notification states that residence and caste certificates issued through the tehsil with an online digital signature will be considered, provided online verification is possible.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will be conducted through the departmental portal on the basis of applications received online and according to the applicable government instructions. The notification specifically states that no written examination or interview will be conducted for the selection process. The merit for Anganwadi Helper will be determined based on educational qualifications from Intermediate up to postgraduate level, as specified in the notification. If no eligible candidate of a particular category is available in the Gram Sabha, selection will be carried out according to the category-wise procedure through the concerned Nyaya Panchayat, as stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: The notification requires candidates to provide accurate certificate and educational qualification details during the online application and verification process. Documents and details specifically referred to in the notification include: Educational qualification certificates and marksheets. High School marksheet and certificate for date-of-birth verification. Residence certificate, where applicable. Caste certificate, where applicable. Income certificate, where applicable. Relevant certificate details required by the online application portal. The notification also instructs applicants to upload clear, readable, self-attested copies of the records/documents whose details are entered in the online application form.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the departmental recruitment portal at upanganwadibharti.in. Open the online application section for the Anganwadi Helper vacancies in Kushinagar district. Read the eligibility requirements and instructions carefully. Check the applicable Gram Panchayat or Ward vacancy before applying. Enter the required personal, educational, caste, income and residence information accurately. Verify certificate numbers, educational qualification details and date-of-birth information before submission. Upload the required clear and readable documents in the prescribed manner. Review the complete application carefully. Submit the application online through the departmental portal. Keep a copy of the submitted application and relevant records for future reference. Important: The notification states that applications sent offline or by post will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible for the advertised Anganwadi Helper vacancies. Applications will be accepted only through the online departmental portal. The applicant must satisfy the prescribed residence requirement for the relevant Gram Sabha or urban ward. Applicants must carefully enter certificate numbers, educational qualification details and other information in the online form. Any incorrect entry or discrepancy in the application will be the responsibility of the applicant. Applications or documents sent offline or through post will not be accepted. If incorrect or false information, marks or educational qualification details are found, the candidate's application or candidature may be rejected. The last date for submitting the online application is 11 September 2026 at 12:00 midnight. The number of vacancies may increase or decrease as reflected on the departmental website. The complete process of Anganwadi Helper selection will be conducted through the departmental portal based on online applications.

content_sections.heading: Kushinagar Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 Important Links
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in similar contractual and honorarium-based positions can also explore more Anganwadi Recruitment Jobs and Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs available across the state. Women candidates looking for more opportunities can also check the latest Women Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to Kanpur can browse more Kushinagar Government Jobs , and those meeting the Intermediate qualification criteria can also explore 12th Pass Government Jobs matching their eligibility.
